booking_text: Choose your experience, explore session pricing, or get in touch to plan your visit.
title: Acupuncture & More | Saltay Hanalei Bay
description: Explore acupuncture, acupressure, fire cupping, botanical support, and Tui Na bodywork at Saltay.
heading: Acupuncture & more
introduction: Explore a thoughtful combination of Chinese medicine traditions and botanical care. Your session is shaped by your preferences and the modalities chosen with your practitioner.
note: Browse 60- and 90-minute session options on our pricing page. Ask us which approach fits your visit.

items.title: Acupuncture
items.text: Fine needles are used at selected points as part of a personalized session. Talk with your practitioner about your goals and preferences.

items.title: Fire cupping
items.text: A cupping technique that lifts the skin with suction. Ask your practitioner how this modality may fit into your chosen session.

items.title: Acupressure
items.text: Pressure is applied to selected points through touch, offering an option for guests who prefer a session without needles.

items.title: Herbal support
items.text: Botanical care may include teas, topical preparations, foot soaks, baths, respiratory steam, or compresses.

items.title: Tui Na bodywork
items.text: A Chinese bodywork tradition using push and pull techniques, performed while fully clothed.

items.title: Contrast therapy
items.text: Warm and cool applications are brought together within the Saltay approach to botanical care.

items.title: Moxibustion
items.text: A traditional modality involving moxa. Discuss the approach with your practitioner when planning your session.

items.title: Energy balancing
items.text: A focus on the flow of energy within your wider Saltay experience.
